description: This file appears to be a C header file defining callback functions for a Non-Volatile Memory (NVM) module, specifically job end and error notifications, within an AUTOSAR-based automotive software system.

methods.name: NvM_JobEndNotification
methods.description: Callback function triggered upon successful completion of a job in the NVM module.

methods.name: NvM_JobErrorNotification
methods.description: Callback function triggered upon an error occurrence in a job in the NVM module.
